# function: ecs_task_definition

Builds the ARN for `ecs` `task-definition`:

```
arn:${Partition}:ecs:${Region}:${Account}:task-definition/${TaskDefinitionFamilyName}:${TaskDefinitionRevisionNumber}
```

The partition, region and account fields come from the configuration file (`.arn.hcl`, or the path in `ARN_CONFIG`). The remaining placeholders are the arguments, in template order.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# arn:aws:ecs:ap-northeast-1:111111111111:task-definition/task-definition-family-name:task-definition-revision-number
output "ecs_task_definition" {
  value = provider::arn::ecs_task_definition("task-definition-family-name", "task-definition-revision-number")
}
```

## Signature

<!-- signature generated by tfplugindocs -->
```text
ecs_task_definition(task_definition_family_name string, task_definition_revision_number string, options map of string...) string
```

## Arguments

<!-- arguments generated by tfplugindocs -->
1. `task_definition_family_name` (String) Value for `${TaskDefinitionFamilyName}` in the ARN template.
1. `task_definition_revision_number` (String) Value for `${TaskDefinitionRevisionNumber}` in the ARN template.
<!-- variadic argument generated by tfplugindocs -->
1. `options` (Variadic, Map of String) Optional overrides: `account` (the name of an `account` block in the configuration file), `account_id` (a literal account id), `region` and `partition`. At most one options map may be given. An unrecognized key, or a value set to an empty string, is an error; omit an option, or set it to `null`, to use the default.
